<script>
  /* api.js is async, so it can fire this callback before the page script at the
     bottom has defined the renderer. Latch here and let whichever runs second
     do the render. */
  window.__ctTurnstileReady = false;
  window.onloadTurnstileCallback = function () {
    window.__ctTurnstileReady = true;
    if (window.__ctRenderTurnstile) window.__ctRenderTurnstile();
  };
</script>

<style>
  .contact-hero { position: relative; min-height: 100vh; display: flex; align-items: stretch; background: radial-gradient(120% 120% at 80% 10%, var(--field-bg) 0%, var(--surface) 50%, var(--surface) 100%); overflow: hidden; }
  .contact-hero #iris { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; z-index: 0; opacity: 0.8; }
  .contact-grid { position: relative; z-index: 2; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; width: 100%; max-width: var(--maxw); margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: var(--gutter); padding-top: calc(var(--nav-h) + 40px); padding-bottom: 60px; gap: clamp(40px, 6vw, 90px); align-items: center; }

  .contact-intro h1 { color: var(--ink); margin: 22px 0 24px; }
  .contact-intro .lead { color: var(--ink-muted); max-width: 44ch; }
  .contact-meta { margin-top: 44px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .cmeta { display: flex; gap: 18px; padding: 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); align-items: baseline; }
  .cmeta .k { font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-ink); width: 88px; flex: none; }
  .cmeta .v { color: var(--ink); font-size: 1.02rem; }
  .cmeta .v a { transition: color 0.3s; }
  .cmeta .v a:hover { color: var(--accent-ink); }
  .cmeta .v small { display: block; color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 0.85rem; margin-top: 4px; }

  /* FORM CARD */
  .form-card { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--line); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); padding: clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 44px); border-radius: 3px; position: relative; }
  .form-card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; width: 64px; background: var(--accent-fill); }
  .form-card h2 { color: var(--ink); font-size: 1.7rem; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .form-card .sub { color: var(--ink-muted); font-size: 0.92rem; margin-bottom: 26px; }
  .field { margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .field label { display: block; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted); margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .field input, .field select, .field textarea {
    width: 100%; background: var(--field-bg); border: 1px solid var(--field-border);
    color: var(--field-ink); font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 0.98rem; padding: 13px 15px; border-radius: 2px;
    transition: border-color 0.3s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.3s var(--ease); outline: none;
  }
  .field input::placeholder, .field textarea::placeholder { color: var(--field-placeholder); }
  .field input:focus, .field select:focus, .field textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent-fill); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--gold-glow); }
  .field textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 96px; }
  .field-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
  .chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
  .chip { font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 100px; color: var(--ink-muted); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s var(--ease); user-select: none; background: transparent; }
  .chip:hover { border-color: var(--line-gold); color: var(--ink); }
  .chip.sel { background: var(--accent-fill); border-color: var(--accent-fill); color: var(--on-accent); font-weight: 600; }
  .form-card .btn { width: 100%; justify-content: center; margin-top: 8px; }
  .form-card .btn[disabled] { opacity: 0.6; pointer-events: none; }
  .hp { position: absolute; left: -9999px; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; }
  .form-error { display: none; color: var(--danger-ink); font-size: 0.86rem; margin: 4px 0 14px; }
  .form-error.show { display: block; }

  .form-success { display: none; text-align: center; padding: 30px 10px; }
  .form-success.show { display: block; animation: fadeUp 0.7s var(--ease); }
  @keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
  .form-success .check { width: 64px; height: 64px; margin: 0 auto 22px; }
  .form-success .check circle { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent-fill); stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 226; stroke-dashoffset: 226; animation: draw 0.8s var(--ease) forwards; }
  .form-success .check path { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent-fill-hover); stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 60; stroke-dashoffset: 60; animation: draw 0.5s var(--ease) 0.5s forwards; }
  @keyframes draw { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
  .form-success h2 { color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .form-success p { color: var(--ink-muted); max-width: 34ch; margin-inline: auto; }

  @media (max-width: 920px) {
    .contact-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; align-items: start; gap: 40px; }
    .contact-hero { min-height: auto; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 480px) { .field-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
</style>

<script>
  (function () {
    /* Posts to our own Pages Function, which verifies the Turnstile token
       server-side before relaying to Formspree. The Formspree URL lives in the
       CONTACT_FORMSPREE_ENDPOINT Pages variable rather than in this page, so it
       cannot be read from source and POSTed to directly. */
    var FORM_ENDPOINT = "/api/contact";
    var CONTACT_EMAIL = "hello@ayinadvisors.com";
    var TURNSTILE_SITEKEY = "0x4AAAAAAFBdMMxC7N5y_3Ya";
    var widgetId = null;

    /* Rendered explicitly so we keep the widget id: the page stays on screen
       after a failed submit and Turnstile tokens are single use, so without a
       reset the visitor could never retry. */
    /* The widget cannot follow our toggle itself (its "auto" follows the operating system), so it takes the theme of the surface it sits on. */ function tsTheme(el) { var p = document.createElement("i"); p.style.color = getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue("--surface"); el.appendChild(p); var m = getComputedStyle(p).color.match(/[\d.]+/g); el.removeChild(p); return (0.2126 * m[0] + 0.7152 * m[1] + 0.0722 * m[2]) / 255 < 0.4 ? "dark" : "light"; }
    window.__ctRenderTurnstile = function () {
      if (widgetId !== null) return;
      widgetId = window.turnstile.render("#ct-turnstile", {
        sitekey: TURNSTILE_SITEKEY,
        action: "contact",
        theme: tsTheme(document.getElementById("ct-turnstile"))
      });
    };
    if (window.__ctTurnstileReady) window.__ctRenderTurnstile();

    var chips = document.getElementById("chips");
    var interests = document.getElementById("interests");
    function syncInterests() {
      if (!chips || !interests) return;
      var picked = [].slice.call(chips.querySelectorAll(".chip.sel"))
        .map(function (c) { return c.getAttribute("data-v"); });
      interests.value = picked.join(", ");
    }
    if (chips) chips.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      var c = e.target.closest(".chip");
      if (c) { c.classList.toggle("sel"); syncInterests(); }
    });

    var form = document.getElementById("consult-form");
    var errEl = document.getElementById("form-error");
    function showError(msg) {
      if (!errEl) return;
      errEl.textContent = msg;
      errEl.classList.add("show");
    }
    function clearError() { if (errEl) errEl.classList.remove("show"); }

    if (form) form.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      clearError();

      // honeypot — silently succeed for bots
      var hp = document.getElementById("company_url");
      if (hp && hp.value) { form.style.display = "none"; document.getElementById("success").classList.add("show"); return; }

      var req = ["name", "company", "email"];
      var bad = [];
      req.forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        var invalid = !el.value.trim() || (id === "email" && !/^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$/.test(el.value));
        el.style.borderColor = invalid ? "var(--danger-ink)" : "";
        if (invalid) { el.setAttribute("aria-invalid", "true"); el.setAttribute("aria-describedby", "form-error"); bad.push(el); }
        else { el.removeAttribute("aria-invalid"); el.removeAttribute("aria-describedby"); }
      });
      if (bad.length) {
        var names = bad.map(function (el) {
          var l = document.querySelector('label[for="' + el.id + '"]');
          return l ? l.textContent.replace(/[*]/g, "").trim() : el.id;
        });
        showError("Please check: " + names.join(", ") + ".");
        bad[0].focus();
        return;
      }

      if (!window.turnstile || !window.turnstile.getResponse(widgetId)) {
        showError("Please complete the verification check above.");
        return;
      }

      syncInterests();
      var done = function () { form.style.display = "none"; document.getElementById("success").classList.add("show"); };

      var btn = form.querySelector(".btn");
      if (btn) { btn.setAttribute("disabled", ""); btn.querySelector(".btn-label").textContent = "Sending…"; }

      function recover(msg) {
        if (btn) { btn.removeAttribute("disabled"); btn.querySelector(".btn-label").textContent = "Send Request"; }
        if (window.turnstile && widgetId !== null) window.turnstile.reset(widgetId);
        showError(msg);
      }

      fetch(FORM_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: new FormData(form) })
        .then(function (res) {
          if (res.ok) { done(); return; }
          recover(res.status === 403
            ? "Verification failed. Please complete the check and try again."
            : "Something went wrong sending your request. Please email " + CONTACT_EMAIL + " instead.");
        })
        .catch(function () {
          recover("Something went wrong sending your request. Please email " + CONTACT_EMAIL + " instead.");
        });
    });
  })();
</script>
